description: Liste des installations d'assainissement collectif dans la Communauté de Communes Cœur de France is a dataset listed in COEUR DE FRANCE open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Communauté de communes Coeur de France. Ce jeu de données regroupe les installations d'assainissement collectifs présentent sur le territoire de la Communauté de communes Cœur de France. Il fournit les informations essentielles pour l’inventaire et le suivi des ouvrages d’assainissement collectif. Champs inclus Nom de la station Commune Type de traitement Capacité nominale (EH) Coordonnées et adresse. Coverage: Cœur de France (Cher). The portal files it under Eau Énergie. Its keywords are EPCI, Assainissement, Eau, Communes. The portal shows 11 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-12-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-cc-coeurdefrance-fr-portal.
